courses.overview: 由差動匯流排、隔離與故障診斷延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend differential buses, isolation and fault diagnosis into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 電力電子電磁干擾濾波

related.difference: 合規頻譜不能代替通訊 bit 錯誤和延遲驗證。
related.differenceEn: Compliance spectra cannot replace bit-error/latency checks.
practice: 把「差動與共模」的概念圖與「電力電子電磁干擾濾波」的輸入輸出對照。
查找跨屏障地線、屏蔽和供電旁路。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：合規頻譜不能代替通訊 bit 錯誤和延遲驗證。
practiceEn: Compare the differential and common mode concept map with inputs/outputs of Power-electronics EMI filtering.
Find ground, shield and power bypasses across the barrier.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Compliance spectra cannot replace bit-error/latency checks.

courses.summary: 工業感測器隔離通訊以差動匯流排、隔離與故障診斷連結元件、系統和驗證。此定位提供公開供應鏈或工程案例的地理背景。
courses.summaryEn: Isolated communications for industrial sensors links components, systems and validation through differential buses, isolation and fault diagnosis. The location gives public supply-chain or case geography.
courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，保留本課的基本模型，重新核對材料、規模、環境與驗收邊界。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Texas Instruments 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。差動接收仍有有限共模範圍。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「差動匯流排、隔離與故障診斷」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Texas Instruments provides a traceable starting point. Differential reception still has a finite common-mode range. Independently authored models connect this to differential buses, isolation and fault diagnosis; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：CMTI 描述快速共模變化下的邏輯可靠性，不等同耐壓。 以「把 dv/dt 條件與靜態電压額定分開檢查。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: CMTI describes logic integrity during fast common-mode transitions, not withstand voltage. Practice interpretation using: Check dv/dt conditions separately from static voltage ratings. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
